shots.name: The Title Assumption
shots.visual: A student holds two printed program flyers, B.Com and BBA, looking frustrated.
shots.dialogue: I thought B.Com was just accounting, so I was only checking BBA for management.

shots.name: The Narrow Research
shots.visual: Student scribbles a giant 'X' over the B.Com flyer.
shots.dialogue: If the titles are different, the subjects must be too, right?
shots.cameraPerformance: Focus on the pen hitting the paper.

shots.name: The Evidence Reveal
shots.visual: Student places two official curriculum PDFs side-by-side, pointing to a highlighted row.
shots.dialogue: Wait. Look at Semester I in both documents.
shots.cameraPerformance: Top-down view of the desk surface.

shots.name: The Overlap Insight
shots.visual: Student looks between the two documents in surprise.
shots.dialogue: The same foundational management course is in both. The title doesn't tell the whole story.
shots.cameraPerformance: Reaction shot, looking into the camera.

shots.name: The Shift in Strategy
shots.visual: Student removes the 'X' from the B.Com flyer and starts listing other modules to compare.
shots.dialogue: What other modules define the actual depth of these programs?
shots.cameraPerformance: Tracking shot showing the student comparing lists.

shots.name: The Research Action
shots.visual: Student neatly aligns both flyers side-by-side on the desk.
shots.dialogue: Check the official programme documents before you decide.
shots.cameraPerformance: Final wide shot of the organized desk.
